description: Land Acquisition - Pahala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Durakanda, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Kendangamu Town, Eheliyagoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders for taking possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the land acquisition authority being exercised.
